plain_english:
12. NOTICE PERIOD DURING PROBATION
During the probation period, the notice period shall be 30 days from either side.
what_it_means_for_you: Contradictory notice period: says 30 days probation notice here, but clause 2 stated 15 days.
risk_reasons: Contradictory probation notice periods: clause 2 says 15 days, clause 12 says 30 days.
evidence_quote: During the probation period, the notice period shall be 30 days from either side.
